name: neon-soup
description: Peer-to-peer execution layer for Cardano DeFi with a deep exploration for cypherpunk values

scripts.build: pnpm run build:open && pnpm run build:close && pnpm run build:swap
scripts.serve: pnpm run serve:prepare && gamechanger-cli preprod snippet html -v 2 -S -o ./dist/index.html -f ./dist/intents/open.gcscript.json --snippetArgsFile ./config/snippet-args.json
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src/ --ext gcscript,json,jsonc,hl,txt --ignore examples/ --exec "pnpm run build && pnpm run serve"
